test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The company will launch the new product next month, and they are already promoting it through various marketing channels.

options.text: The new product will be launched by the company next month, and it is already being promoted through various marketing channels.
The new product were been launched by the company next month, and it already was promoting through various marketing channels.
The new product was launched by the company next month, and it is already promoted through various marketing channels.
The new product will have been launched by the company next month, and it was already being promoted through various marketing channels.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct **passive voice** construction involves changing the object of the** active sentence** into the subject of the **passive sentence.**
 
• The new subjec**t (the new product)** is followed by the appropriate form of the verb** "to be" (will be)** and the **past participle of the main verb (launched).**
 
• The second part of the sentence also needs to be in passive voice:** "it is already being promoted."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The new product will be launched by the company next month, and it is already being promoted through various marketing channels."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Contains incorrect verb forms "were been" and "was promoting," making it grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 3:** Uses incorrect future tense "was launched" and does not use passive voice correctly in the second part.
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect future perfect tense "will have been launched" and incorrect past continuous "was already being promoted."
